data.one_liner: A dynamic grid layout package for Flutter inspired by Bootstrap and Material UI breakpoints.
data.what_it_does: Provides SpGrid and SpGridItem widgets to create responsive layouts using a 12-column grid system based on MediaQuery breakpoints. It supports customizable breakpoints and item ordering.
use_when: You need a Bootstrap-style or Material-UI style 12-column grid system in Flutter.
You want responsive grid layouts that adapt to screen widths using MediaQuery.
avoid_when: You need complex staggered grid layouts (use flutter_staggered_grid_view instead).
You prefer layout approaches that avoid MediaQuery rebuilds.
strengths: Familiar concepts for developers coming from Bootstrap or Material-UI grids.
Customizable breakpoints and built-in item ordering capabilities.
weaknesses: Relies directly on MediaQuery for layout sizing.
Limited documentation outside of basic grid and order examples.

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need advanced staggered, tile, or masonry grid layouts rather than a standard 12-column row-based layout.
